data.one_liner: A wrapper for scrollable widgets that enables smooth mouse scrolling across all platforms.
data.what_it_does: Wraps scrollable widgets to animate smooth scrolling based on mouse scroll speed. It detects platforms using universal_io and automatically updates scroll physics.
use_when: You want smooth mouse scrolling on Flutter desktop or web apps
You need to animate scroll events based on user scroll speed
avoid_when: You prefer default platform-specific choppy mouse scrolling behavior
You do not use scrollable widgets
strengths: Enables smooth scrolling with a mouse on all platforms
Automatically detects mobile vs desktop platforms and adjusts physics
Allows customizing scroll duration and mobile physics
weaknesses: Initial release lacks detailed changelog documentation
Relies on external provider and universal_io packages
data.minimal_example:
DynMouseScroll(
  builder: (context, controller, physics) => ListView(
    controller: controller,
    physics: physics,
    children: ...
    )
)
